name: Bangalore Palace
short_text: Royal palace with Tudor and Scottish Gothic architecture.
long_text: An exemplary of royal exuberance, Bangalore Palace was built in 1878. The palace's architecture is a mix of Tudor and Scottish Gothic styles with fortified towers, arches, and green lawns.
audio_text: You are near Bangalore Palace, a royal residence built in 1878. It's known for its unique blend of Tudor and Scottish Gothic architecture.

name: Vidhana Soudha
short_text: The seat of Karnataka's state legislature, known for its imposing Neo-Dravidian architecture.
long_text: The Vidhana Soudha is the seat of the state legislature of Karnataka. It is an imposing building, constructed in a style sometimes described as Mysore Neo-Dravidian, and incorporates elements of Indo-Saracenic and Dravidian styles. The construction was completed in 1956.
audio_text: You are looking at Vidhana Soudha, the state legislative building of Karnataka. It was completed in 1956 and is a prime example of Neo-Dravidian architecture.

name: Lalbagh Botanical Garden
short_text: Historic garden from 1760, famous for its glass house and annual flower shows.
long_text: A renowned centre for botanical artwork and conservation, Lalbagh was commissioned by Hyder Ali in 1760. It is famous for its glass house which hosts two annual flower shows and houses a rare collection of tropical plants.
audio_text: This is the Lalbagh Botanical Garden, started in 1760. It is famous for its large glass house and a vast collection of tropical plants.

name: Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace
short_text: The summer residence of Tipu Sultan, built with teakwood in the Indo-Islamic style.
long_text: Located inside the Bangalore Fort, this palace was the summer residence of the Mysorean ruler Tipu Sultan. Its structure is made mostly of teakwood and is a great example of Indo-Islamic architecture.
audio_text: You are at Tipu Sultan's Summer Palace. This beautiful teakwood structure was the ruler's summer retreat and showcases Indo-Islamic design.

name: Cubbon Park
short_text: A major landmark and green lung in the heart of the city, home to over 6,000 trees.
long_text: A major landmark, Cubbon Park is a green lung in the heart of the city. It is home to more than 6,000 trees and houses the State Central Library, an aquarium, and the Bal Bhavan.
audio_text: You have arrived at Cubbon Park, a vast green space in the city center. It's a perfect place for a walk among thousands of trees.

name: ISKCON Temple Bangalore

long_text: One of the largest ISKCON temples in the world, this cultural complex is dedicated to Radha and Krishna. It is known for its stunning blend of modern technology and spiritual harmony.
audio_text: This is the ISKCON Temple in Bangalore, one of the largest of its kind. It is a modern architectural marvel dedicated to Radha and Krishna.

name: Bull Temple (Dodda Basavana Gudi)
short_text: Famous for its huge monolith statue of the sacred bull, Nandi, carved from a single rock.
long_text: Located in Basavanagudi, this temple is famous for its huge monolith statue of the sacred bull Nandi. The statue is said to have been carved out of a single piece of rock.
audio_text: You are now at the Bull Temple. Its main attraction is the massive statue of Nandi the bull, which was carved from a single stone.

name: Visvesvaraya Industrial & Technological Museum

long_text: Located near Cubbon Park, this museum is a tribute to the father of modern Karnataka, Sir M. Visvesvaraya. It houses various scientific experiments and engines, making science fun and interactive.
audio_text: This is the Visvesvaraya Museum, a fantastic place for science lovers. It features many hands-on exhibits that explain scientific concepts.

name: Attara Kacheri (High Court)
short_text: The striking red brick building that houses the High Court of Karnataka.
long_text: This striking red brick building, located opposite Vidhana Soudha, houses the High Court of Karnataka. Built in 1868, its name literally means 'eighteen offices' or departments.
audio_text: In front of you is the Attara Kacheri, a beautiful red building that serves as the High Court of Karnataka. It stands directly opposite the Vidhana Soudha.

name: St. Mary's Basilica
short_text: The oldest church in Bangalore, built in the Gothic style and famous for its annual feast.
long_text: The oldest church in Bangalore, St. Mary's Basilica is a prominent landmark in the Shivaji Nagar area. It is famous for the St. Mary's Feast, held every September, which attracts thousands of devotees.
audio_text: You are at St. Mary's Basilica, the oldest church in Bangalore. It is known for its beautiful Gothic architecture and the grand St. Mary's Feast held in September.

name: National Gallery of Modern Art
short_text: Showcases Indian art from the 18th century to the present day in a historic mansion.
long_text: Housed in the historic Manikyavelu Mansion, this gallery showcases Indian art starting from the early 18th century to the present day. It's a must-visit for art lovers.
audio_text: Welcome to the National Gallery of Modern Art. Inside this historic mansion, you'll find a vast collection of Indian art spanning several centuries.

name: Bangalore Fort
short_text: Originally a mud fort from 1537, with only parts like the Delhi Gate remaining today.
long_text: Originally a mud fort built by Kempe Gowda I in 1537, it was later converted into a stone fort by Hyder Ali. Today, only parts of it, like the well-preserved Delhi Gate, remain.
audio_text: This is a remnant of the historic Bangalore Fort. Originally built in 1537, the impressive Delhi Gate is one of the few parts still standing.

name: Gavi Gangadhareshwara Temple
short_text: A unique rock-cut temple where sunlight illuminates the deity on Makar Sankranti.

audio_text: You are at the Gavi Gangadhareshwara Temple, a fascinating cave temple. It is famous for a special event in January when the sun's rays directly light up the idol.

name: HAL Heritage Centre and Aerospace Museum

long_text: India's first aerospace museum, it showcases the growth of the Indian aviation industry and Hindustan Aeronautics Limited for over six decades. You can see various aircraft and helicopters here.
audio_text: This is the HAL Aerospace Museum, the first of its kind in India. It chronicles the journey of Indian aviation with impressive exhibits of planes and helicopters.

name: Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium

long_text: A popular attraction for science enthusiasts, this planetarium hosts fascinating shows about the wonders of the universe, making astronomy accessible and exciting for all ages.
audio_text: You are near the Jawaharlal Nehru Planetarium. It offers amazing sky-theatre shows that take you on a journey through the cosmos.

name: Ulsoor Lake

audio_text: This is Ulsoor Lake, one of the biggest lakes in the city. It's a great spot to relax or enjoy a boat ride.

name: Karnataka Chitrakala Parishath

audio_text: This is the M. Chinnaswamy Stadium, a celebrated cricket ground. It's the home stadium for the city's popular IPL team, Royal Challengers Bangalore.

audio_text: This is the Indira Gandhi Musical Fountain Park. In the evenings, you can watch a beautiful show where fountains dance to the rhythm of music.

long_text: Gandhi Bhavan is a memorial dedicated to Mahatma Gandhi. It houses a gallery showcasing pictures of his life, a library with his works, and serves as a center for promoting Gandhian values and philosophy.
audio_text: This is Gandhi Bhavan, a memorial dedicated to Mahatma Gandhi. Here, you can learn about his incredible life and timeless teachings through pictures and books.

name: Kadu Malleshwara Temple, Malleshwaram

long_text: The Kadu Malleshwara Temple is an ancient Hindu temple dedicated to Lord Shiva, located in the Malleshwaram locality. It was built in the 17th century in the Dravidian style of architecture. The area 'Malleshwaram' derives its name from this temple.

name: Hebbal Lake Park

name: Madiwala Lake

name: Savandurga Hill

audio_text: This is Savandurga hill, one of the largest single rock formations in all of Asia. It is a very popular destination for trekking and rock climbing enthusiasts.

name: Mayo Hall
short_text: A historic public building with panoramic views, now housing government offices.
long_text: Mayo Hall is a two-story historic building located on M.G. Road. It was built in honor of Lord Mayo, the 4th Viceroy of India. The upper floor offers panoramic views of the city's landmarks.
audio_text: You are at Mayo Hall, a historic building from the British era. It was named after a former Viceroy of India and is known for its beautiful architecture.

name: Bangalore Aquarium
short_text: The second largest aquarium in India, located in Cubbon Park.
long_text: The Bangalore Aquarium is the second largest aquarium in India and is located at the entrance of Cubbon Park. It has a variety of ornamental and exotic fish on display in its octagonal building.
audio_text: This is the Bangalore Aquarium, located inside Cubbon Park. It's a great place to see a wide variety of beautiful and exotic fish.

name: Chokkanathaswamy Temple, Domlur
short_text: One of the oldest temples in Bangalore, dating back to the 10th century Chola period.
long_text: The Chokkanathaswamy Temple in Domlur is one of the oldest temples in the city, built in the 10th century by the Cholas. It is dedicated to the deity Vishnu and features impressive Tamil inscriptions on its walls.
audio_text: You are at the Chokkanathaswamy Temple, one of Bangalore's oldest temples. It was built by the Chola dynasty in the 10th century and is a treasure of history.

name: Karnataka Folk Museum
short_text: A museum showcasing the folk arts, crafts, and culture of Karnataka.
long_text: The Karnataka Folk Museum, located on the Bangalore University campus, is a vibrant repository of the state's folk culture. It features a rich collection of folk art, puppets, musical instruments, and traditional costumes.
audio_text: This is the Karnataka Folk Museum. It's a wonderful place to explore the rich and diverse folk traditions, art, and culture of the state of Karnataka.

name: Hesaraghatta Lake
short_text: A man-made freshwater lake and popular spot for birdwatching.
long_text: Hesaraghatta Lake is a man-made reservoir created in 1894 to meet the city's water needs. Today, it is a dry lakebed for much of the year but remains an important grassland habitat and a prime location for birdwatching.
audio_text: This is Hesaraghatta Lake, a large man-made lakebed. Though often dry, it is a very important habitat for grasslands and a fantastic place to spot birds.

name: Janapada Loka
short_text: A folk arts museum that aims to preserve and promote Karnataka's rural culture.
long_text: Janapada Loka, meaning 'Folk World', is an institution dedicated to preserving and promoting the folk culture of Karnataka. Located near Ramanagara, it features a folk museum, an open-air theatre, and exhibits of traditional village life.
audio_text: This is Janapada Loka, a 'Folk World' dedicated to Karnataka's rural traditions. It's a great place to experience the state's authentic folk art and culture.
